records.title: HongTu: Scalable Full-Graph GNN Training on Multiple GPUs
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 HongTu moves GNN training vertex data to CPU and uses partitioning, recomputation/caching and deduplicated transfers; it reports lower communication and speedups for billion-scale graph training. This is a GNN training system rather than LLM inference/offload, so transfer to the linked LLM training-memory family is indirect.

records.title: Temporal Chain of Thought: Long-Video Understanding by Thinking in Frames
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 Temporal CoT repeatedly selects relevant video frames with a VLM and uses more inference-time compute to improve QA; a 32K-context run beats a 700K standard run by 2.8 points on long LVBench videos. It trades additional selection compute for context/quality in video QA, not a demonstrated serving-cost reduction.

records.title: SWE-Dev: Building Software Engineering Agents with Training and Inference Scaling
records.reason: 一次資料abstractおよび本文を確認。SWE-Dev scales training trajectories and data for software-engineering agents; evaluation reports task success rates. It does not present distributed attention or a long-context inference systems method.

records.title: GSArch: Breaking Memory Barriers in 3D Gaussian Splatting Training via Architectural Support
records.reason: 一次出版社資料でabstractは確認したが全文を取得できず、method/evaluation/limitationsおよび系統との接続を検証できないためborderlineに残す。 The publisher abstract identifies a 3D Gaussian Splatting training accelerator with hot/cold on-chip memory, gradient filtering and memory-request rearrangement. The reported speedups concern 3DGS, not transformer attention; publisher full text was inaccessible, so the sparse-attention relationship remains unresolved.
